create_layer_drop_module_list: create a LayerDropModuleList with dropout probability p and a list of nn modules
build_layer_drop_module_list: build a LayerDropModuleList that randomly drops layers during training with configurable dropout probability
iterate_layer_drop_module_list: iterate over a LayerDropModuleList to apply non-dropped layers to input tensor during training
review_layer_drop_module_list: review the LayerDropModuleList class and its stochastic layer dropout behavior during training
summarize_layer_drop_module_list: summarize the LayerDropModuleList class which implements LayerDrop as described in arXiv 1909.11556
